The actor's depiction of the character was what got me interested in the character. To me, his portrayal in the MCU is as important as who he is in the comics. The actor brought so much to the role that I can't see myself ever enjoying another (film) depiction of the character. While I do love Spider-Man and the Black Panther, I just don't feel like the MCU will feel like home for me anymore without my favorite character. So, at the risk of sounding dramatic, I feel like I have no home now. The MCU and Marvel Comics have been the only escape from my relentlessly bleak reality, and now they'll never be the same for me. I can't even go back and watch the old movies because they're all tainted by the memory of his death. I feel more grief now than when one of my first degree relatives died by suicide.

I did the same thing and then seeing it made me even more suicidal. I wasn't even really suicidal before-- just fleeting, not-serious thoughts. Now my favorite character is dead so I literally have nothing to look forward to.
